name: Capillary Ripples
desc: Rain on still water, rendered by its dispersion: because surface tension carries short waves faster than gravity carries long ones, every impact ring turns inside out — a hair-fine fringe of capillary ripples sprints out ahead while the fat swell it was born with lags behind and the water inside falls quiet again; as a dark pond mirroring a bright sky, a false-color map of the local wavelength, liquid mercury, optical iso-fringes, or a sumi ink pond.

energy.doc: wave amplitude, wind-ripple texture and glint intensity (the master knob)

scale.doc: capillary length — the whole wave scale, from a fine misted surface to slow heavy swell

speed.doc: time rate — impact frequency and how fast the rings run out

density.doc: how many impacts are live at once, and how often they fall

tension.doc: surface tension vs gravity — slides the balance between a long rolling swell and a surface shivering with fine capillary fringe

hue.doc: hue of the water (the mirrored sky takes the complement)

x.doc: center of the impact zone across the pond

y.doc: center of the impact zone down the pond

style.doc: aesthetic: dark pond mirroring a bright sky / abstracted false-color map of the LOCAL wavelength / liquid mercury under hard specular / optical iso-fringes / sumi ink pond

seed.doc: deterministic seed for impact placement, timing and the wind-ripple spectrum
